title: Certify ites of store chains compared with store chains in Lean
summary: The Lean reconstructor now states a Lean-proved extensionality converse for each pair of leaves when an array equality has an ite of different store chains over constant arrays on a side, so Z3's rewrite step for such equalities is accepted by Lean. This closes the last failing seed of the iteration-88 constant-array sweeps without adding any trusted step.
